name: com.get-flowie/docs
title: Flowie Developer Docs
description: Search and read the Flowie Exchange API docs and OpenAPI contract. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search the Flowie Exchange API documentation and return the most relevant pages with their URLs and descriptions. Use this first when you need to find where something is documented.

query.description: What to search for, in natural language or keywords.

tools.name: docs_read_page
tools.description: Read a documentation page as markdown. Accepts a full URL from search_docs, or a path such as /reference/ or /guides/send-invoice.

tools.name: docs_list_endpoints
tools.description: List the API's operations (method, path, summary) from the OpenAPI contract, optionally filtered by a substring of the path or summary.

format.description: 'list' for method/path/summary lines (default), or 'openapi' for the raw OpenAPI definition.

path.description: With format=openapi, return just this path, e.g. /v1/documents/send.

tools.name: docs_get_auth_guide
tools.description: Return the authentication walkthrough for agents: how to get a sandbox key with no signup, how a user hands an agent scoped access, error handling and revocation.

section.description: Optional section to return: discover, register, claim, use, errors, revocation.

tools.name: sandbox_create_credential
tools.description: Mint a working sandbox API key with no signup and no human in the loop. Returns an apiKey (flw_test_...), an organizationId, a seeded company with a Peppol id, and suggested next steps. Sandbox data is synthetic and never reaches a real network - never send real personal data to it. This key gives no access to any real account.

includeNextSteps.description: Include the suggested next-step instructions in the result. Default true. Set false when you already know the flow and only want the credential.
